job.title: Lead Sitecore Architect (XM Cloud)
job.description:
Role: Lead Sitecore Architect (XM Cloud)
Location: Remote (Pitching for Switzerland-based client)
Languages: Fluent German & English
Contract Duration: 12 Months (Pending pitch win; immediate start upon award)
 
Overview
We are seeking an experienced German-Speaking Sitecore Architect with specialized expertise in Sitecore XM Cloud to join our team for a high-profile client pitch in Switzerland and lead the technical execution upon project award.
In the immediate phase, your profile will be featured in our proposal deck, and you will participate in client pitch presentations (remote). Upon winning the pitch, you will step directly into a 12-month contract as the technical lead driving the Sitecore XM Cloud solution architecture.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Pre-Sales & Pitch Support: Partner with our pitching team to present technical capabilities and architecture strategy to the client in German.
  • Architecture & Design: Design end-to-end composable DXP solutions leveraging Sitecore XM Cloud, modern headless frameworks, and API-first architectures.
  • Technical Leadership: Serve as the subject matter expert on Sitecore XM Cloud capabilities, migration strategies, content modeling, and integrations.
  • Client Advisory: Act as the trusted technical consultant for the Swiss client, translating complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Best Practices: Establish development standards, CI/CD pipelines, and governance for headless CMS implementations.
Requirements
  • Sitecore Expertise: Proven track record as a Sitecore Architect with hands-on experience in Sitecore XM Cloud implementations.
  • Language Skills: Native/Fluent German (required for client communications) and professional working proficiency in English.
  • Headless Architecture: Strong experience with modern headless technologies (e.g., Next.js, React, GraphQL, REST APIs).
  • Pre-Sales/Consulting Experience: Comfortable presenting architectural concepts to C-level stakeholders and client pitch panels.
  • Availability: Immediate availability for remote pitch calls and a 12-month full-time commitment upon contract win.

job.title: Greenlight Expert
job.description:
Greenlight Expert
Contract Length: 12 months
Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands (fully office-based - no hybrid or remote work)
Languages Required: Dutch and English
  
About the Role
We are looking for a customer-focused Greenlight Expert to join a fast-paced support hub environment. This role involves providing in-person and virtual support to driver-partners and prospective drivers, assisting them with onboarding, account-related queries, documentation, and platform support.
The ideal candidate will have strong customer service experience, preferably within a face-to-face support environment, and be comfortable handling a high volume of enquiries while escalating more complex issues when required.
  
Key Responsibilities
  • Provide professional in-person and virtual support to driver-partners and prospective drivers.
  • Assist with account setup, onboarding, and document verification processes.
  • Troubleshoot issues relating to accounts, payments, trips, documents, and mobile application functionality.
  • Guide partners through platform policies, updates, and best practices.
  • Deliver a high standard of customer service while maintaining operational efficiency.
  • Escalate and follow up on more complex cases with internal support teams.
  • Maintain accurate records and ensure compliance with internal procedures.
  • Contribute to a positive, collaborative, and supportive team environment.
  
Requirements
  • Fluent in both Dutch and English.
  • Previous customer support or customer service experience required.
  • Comfortable working in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple queries efficiently and professionally.

job.title: Senior Payroll Specialist (Reading)
job.description:
Senior Payroll Specialist
Location: Reading / London
Contract: 12-Month Contract
Working Pattern: Hybrid
Sector: Global Organisation
 
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Senior Payroll Specialist to take ownership of the end-to-end payroll administration for Israel, ensuring accurate, timely and fully compliant payroll processing.
This is a key role within the payroll function, working closely with HR Shared Services, Benefits, Total Rewards, Finance, Compliance, Risk and external payroll vendors. The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert for Israel payroll while also supporting payroll activities across other countries, with full training provided.
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage end-to-end Israel payroll processing, from payroll inputs through to final outputs and payments.
  • Ensure payroll is processed accurately, on time and in line with local legislation and tax regulations.
  • Manage employee onboarding and termination processes from a payroll perspective.
  • Complete monthly and annual tax and social security reporting and payments.
  • Manage year-end payroll activities, including Form 101 processes.
  • Ensure all payroll inputs are accurate and identify processes that may impact payroll.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure correct and timely payroll data.
  • Manage payroll-related queries relating to tax, finance, pensions, expenses, insurance and benefits.
  • Manage payroll vendors and other payroll-related service providers.
  • Support payroll audits, risk management and compliance activities.
  • Prepare and maintain payroll documentation, processes and procedures.
  • Support payroll system changes, implementations and improvement projects.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for Israel payroll and provide guidance to wider payroll management and cross-functional teams.
  • Support the processing of payroll for other countries as required, with full training provided.
  • Contribute to payroll projects and initiatives as an individual contributor.
Essential Experience & Skills
  • 4+ years' experience operating and running Israel payroll.
  • Active Israeli payroll licence valid for payroll practice in Israel - essential.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Har-Gal and/or Hilan payroll systems - essential.
  • Proven end-to-end payroll processing experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Israeli employment legislation, tax and social security requirements.
  • Experience with pensions, expenses, insurance and benefits payroll administration.
  • Strong understanding of payroll compliance and tax calculations across different pay elements.
  • Experience working with payroll vendors and other HR/payroll systems.
  • Experience supporting payroll system changes, implementations or projects is desirable.
  • Strong experience working with cross-functional teams including HR Shared Services, Benefits, Total Rewards, Finance, Compliance and Risk.
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
  • Good MS Office skills, particularly Excel.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet tight payroll deadlines.
  • A collaborative team player with the ability to work independently.
What We're Looking For
We are looking for someone with broad payroll and organisational knowledge who can operate as a trusted point of expertise for Israel payroll. You will be accountable for the full payroll lifecycle, while also helping to improve processes, manage risk and ensure continued compliance.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Israel Payroll Specialist to join a global organisation on an initial 12-month contract, with exposure to wider international payroll operations and projects.
 
Apply now to find out more about this opportunity.

job.title: VAT Consultant - Compliance
job.description:
VAT Consultant - Compliance
Location: Reading, UK
Working Practice: Hybrid
We are currently recruiting for a VAT Consultant - Compliance to join an in-house Indirect Tax team based in Reading.
This is an excellent opportunity for a VAT professional with strong compliance experience to take on a regional role, supporting VAT and indirect tax obligations across multiple EMEA and APAC jurisdictions. You will work closely with internal finance teams and external tax advisors to ensure accurate and timely reporting and compliance.
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage the end-to-end VAT compliance cycle across multiple EMEA and APAC countries.
  • Oversee the preparation and submission of VAT returns, sales and purchase listings, Intrastat and other indirect tax filings.
  • Liaise with internal finance teams and external tax service providers.
  • Provide source reports, review draft VAT returns and assess GL account reconciliations.
  • Ensure all required internal governance and approval processes are completed.
  • Coordinate timely VAT payments and filing approvals.
  • Review VAT exception reports, identify data anomalies and support the resolution of system or transactional issues.
  • Support indirect tax audits and enquiries by gathering relevant data and documentation.
  • Work with external advisors and the wider VAT team to support audit defence activities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve, streamline and automate VAT compliance processes.
About You
We are looking for someone with:
  • 3-5 years' hands-on experience in VAT compliance.
  • Previous experience within an in-house tax or finance environment is highly desirable.
  • Experience across multiple EMEA and/or APAC jurisdictions.
  • Strong knowledge of VAT/GST principles and compliance requirements.
  • Experience working with external tax advisors and internal finance stakeholders.
  • A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Taxation, Business or a related discipline.
  • A recognised VAT/indirect tax qualification such as CTA, ATT or regional equivalent.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as SAP would be advantageous.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify discrepancies and resolve compliance issues.
  • A proactive approach to process improvement and automation.
What's on Offer?
  • In-house VAT/Indirect Tax opportunity
  • Exposure to EMEA and APAC jurisdictions
  • Hybrid working from Reading
  • Opportunity to work closely with senior tax and finance stakeholders
  • Strong scope for process improvement and automation
If you're an experienced VAT compliance professional looking for an opportunity to broaden your international exposure within an in-house environment, we'd love to hear from you.
